Shared Context Lab | Member of Technical Staff | San Francisco or New York | ONSITE | Full-time

Shared Context Lab (https://sharedcontextlab.com) is building adaptive personal AI that understands the texture of real life: relationships, routines, responsibilities, and goals. Our closed beta is garnering very positive feedback and retention. We’re venture backed + incubated at iconic design firm IDEO.

We’re looking for a senior, hands-on engineer to tackle:

- Core agent, product, and infrastructure systems

- Context, memory, orchestration, and tool use

- Simulation environments for users, schedules, relationships, and multi-agent interactions

- Evaluations for long-horizon agent behavior, reliability, and safety

We care a lot about high agency, collaboration, and high ownership mentality. Strong product judgment and care for user experience matter as much as technical rigor.

Apply here: https://sharedcontextlab.com/mts or reach out at join@sharedcontextlab.com
